name: AI Tool Center

sources.title: AI Tool Center - Submit Tool (free requires footer backlink; Google login + captcha)
AI Tool Center - Pricing (Free $0 w/ backlink, Starter $9.9 one-time, Pro $29.9/mo)
AI Tool Center homepage - AI tools directory, 2000+ listings

conditions: Free plan ($0): review in 5-7 days and a 'DR:51 dofollow link' - but ONLY 'as long as you maintain our backlink': you must add their link (AI Tool Center) to your site's footer and keep it
Starter plan ($9.9 one-time): review in 36 hours, dofollow link, NO backlink required
Pro plan ($29.9/mo): homepage + site-wide footer placement and multiple dofollow links
requirements: AI tools/products only (directory of 2,000+ AI websites/tools)
Sign-in required: 'Please continue by logging in' with Google - and the login only works in Chrome, Edge, or Safari per the page's own warning
Submit form fields: Tool Name, Tool URL, Your Email, plus a captcha
Free tier explicitly requires embedding their footer backlink code before/after submitting ('To get a free dofollow link, you need to add and keep a backlink to aitoolcenter.com on your website')
preparation: A Google account usable in Chrome/Edge/Safari for login
The footer backlink snippet ready to place on your site if taking the free plan
Or a payment method for Starter $9.9 (one-time) to skip the backlink
workflow: Open https://aitoolcenter.com/submit in Chrome, Edge, or Safari
Sign in with Google (the page insists other browsers won't work for login)
Fill Tool Name, Tool URL, Your Email, and complete the captcha
For free: paste their footer link code onto your site, acknowledge 'I Understand', submit, and keep the link - review in 5-7 days
For paid: use 'Submit Pack' / pricing (Starter $9.9 one-time, Pro $29.9/mo) for faster/no-backlink listing
watchFor: Reciprocal-link condition: the dofollow backlink lasts only 'as long as you maintain our backlink' - removing it forfeits the listing's value
Browser-locked Google login - the site itself says to use 'Chrome', 'Edge', or 'Safari'
Footer spam-links galore ('Friends' link swaps) - typical of this directory family; no extra requirements implied
Pro plan is a subscription ($29.9/mo) while Starter is one-time ($9.9) - pick deliberately
countsAsLive: The tool has a public detail page on aitoolcenter.com after review (5-7 days free / 36h paid)
unknowns: Whether the backlink is verified automatically or manually, and how often re-checked
Whether the captcha/login is enforced on the paid path too
Rejection criteria beyond the backlink check
